# gramlot-py-server 0.3.31 — terminal socket

- The uvicorn and Kajenn adapters serve the terminal socket `<mount>/gramlot/terminal` for the `terminal` component of core 0.3.36: one binary WebSocket message per frame, same-origin check, sessions opened by `@terminal` PageStore methods.
- Requires gramlot 0.3.36.

Qualification: full test suite green on GitHub Actions (published core, every host adapter, browser checks).
